findings.title: saveU() throws uncaught on QuotaExceededError from localStorage.setItem with no user-visible surface
findings.symptom: localStorage.setItem throwing QuotaExceededError (a real, common browser condition once a user's save nears the 5-10MB LS cap) propagates straight out of saveU() with no catch, no toast, no export offer — the write is silently lost from the caller's perspective beyond an uncaught exception. This is exactly the ‘worlds persist forever’ promise failing silently the spec's §8(c) is testing for.
